slides.headline: Coastal Corgi Classic at Gulfstream Park, Oct. 10
slides.body: Corgis race on Gulfstream Park’s main dirt track in Hallandale Beach on Saturday, Oct. 10. Check-in is 11 a.m., the costume contest is at noon, and the first race is at 1 p.m.
